name: Linear Teams
description: Teams are organizational units inside Linear workspaces that group people, issues, projects, cycles, workflows, templates, and team-specific settings.
agentUseSummary: Linear Teams is not offered as a separate Relay connection. Users connect the canonical Linear provider, whose workspace OAuth grant and typed runtime already include bounded team discovery alongside issue and project workflows; this avoids duplicate OAuth, workspace binding, policies, and cards.

providerSetup.blocker: Linear Teams is a workspace resource family, not a separate provider or authentication surface. Linear documents teams as containers inside a workspace, and OAuth team access is part of the app's Linear workspace authorization.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this alias unpublished and direct users to the canonical Linear card and connection. Re-evaluate only if Linear launches a separately authenticated product with distinct API authority, lifecycle, and customer data.

evidence.supports: Linear documents a workspace as containing one or more teams; teams organize issues, projects, cycles, documents, workflows, templates, and members rather than forming a separate product.
Linear documents the workspace as the home for all issues and interactions and automatically creates a default team inside each workspace.
Linear documents one workspace OAuth authorization whose app-user team access can be adjusted; it does not define a separate Linear Teams OAuth product.
